name: Bird dog
summary: On hands and knees, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, hold, return.
setup: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips, side-on to the phone at knee height. Reach the near arm forward and the far leg back until both are level with the back. Hold without the back twisting, then return.
brief: Hands under the shoulders, knees under the hips. Reach the near arm forward and the far leg back until both are level with the back.
why: From the side the reaching arm and the extended leg both approach horizontal, so the timer runs only while both are held up.
progression: Longer holds; draw the elbow and knee together between reps.

faults.label: Hips twisting
faults.tip: Imagine a glass of water on the lower back; the leg lifts only as high as the hips can stay square.

faults.label: Lower back arching
faults.tip: Lift the leg to level with the back, no higher.

faults.label: Lifting the leg too high
faults.cue: Heel no higher than the hip
faults.tip: Above hip height the lower back arches. Reach long behind you instead of high.

points.t: Extends back to level, not above.
